system_deps_attempt.notes: USE_SYSTEM_DEPS=ON switches the broader native dependency chain to pkg-config/system packages, not only qpdf.

temporary_sdist_patches: qpdf: declare libqpdf.a as an ExternalProject BUILD_BYPRODUCT and force the Linux sub-build to static output
jpeg/openjpeg/lcms2/freetype: declare imported static libraries as ExternalProject BUILD_BYPRODUCTS
lcms2: pass --disable-dependency-tracking to the autotools configure step
qpdf: pass the vendored externals directory as CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH
docling_parse_followup.current_blocker: qpdf sub-build cannot find zlib/libjpeg through pkg-config during its own configure step

handoff.thermal_note: Build attempts were stopped when CPU package temperature exceeded 90C; do not resume the patched source build unless the free-threaded Docling question is explicitly reopened.

classic_docling_limited_stress.meaning: Real Docling works with the runner in a classic interpreter for a low-risk CPU thread matrix; this is not free-threaded Docling compatibility evidence.

closure.reason: Docling production pins cannot currently be installed in the free-threaded cp314t environment without upstream/native packaging work.
closure.production_assessment: Docling is intentionally isolated out of the Python worker thread path as a killable process/service, so moving it into a free-threaded worker would remove an operational safety property rather than improve current capacity.
